headline: Mexico Retail Sales Rise 1.2% in August, Surpassing Forecasts
summary: Mexico's retail sales rose 1.2% in August, quadruple the 0.3% forecast, leaving Banxico fewer reasons to cut its 6.50% interest rate.
why: Retail sales data measures consumer demand and economic health, which directly guides central bank monetary policy and currency valuations in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Surpassing retail sales forecasts provides Banxico with fewer reasons to cut its 6.50% interest rate.
